name: Tanuki Justice SWITCH [ESRB]
description:
Tanuki Justice is an intensive run ‘n gun in which you play as one of two tanuki siblings. You’ll face hundreds of enemies in feudal Japan across various environments and landscapes and find yourself challenging scenarios reminiscent of good old arcade games. Gameplay is easy to learn, yet difficult to master, allowing for flexibility in combat. A two-player co-op mode is also included for double the fun! You’ll also face powerful bosses that will challenge even the most skilled players, but there is no greater foe than time itself!

Features:
– Dynamic gameplay with visuals that fit the atmosphere.
– Dozens of different types of enemies.
– Classical shurikens over the head and a giant shuriken for difficult moments.
– Playable in single or two-player mode.

Standard Edition (This product is not a limited edition).

name: Rage of the Dragons Neo SWITCH [US]
short_description: Rage of the Dragons fait revivre l’adrénaline des combats en 2D avec un gameplay affiné, des personnages charismatiques et un système de combat en duo qui demande à la fois stratégie et précision. Dans ce jeu, chaque coup compte et chaque décision peut faire la différence entre la victoire et la défaite.
description:
PRÉPAREZ-VOUS A LA FUREUR !

Rage of the Dragons fait revivre l’adrénaline des combats en 2D avec un gameplay affiné, des personnages charismatiques et un système de combat en duo qui demande à la fois stratégie et précision. Dans ce jeu, chaque coup compte et chaque décision peut faire la différence entre la victoire et la défaite.
Rage of the Dragons NEO est une version PC de Rage of the Dragons, sorti en 2002 sur arcade. C’était un jeu unique et innovant, notamment grâce à ses visuels et à ses aspects techniques très appréciés à l’époque. Avec ses décors et animations superbes, ses coups spectaculaires et une bande-son acclamée, il est incontournable pour tout amateur de jeux de combat.
Réputé pour sa grande difficulté, Rage of the Dragons NEO est basé sur des combats en tag team où le joueur utilise deux personnages, en contrôlant un à la fois, avec la possibilité d’alterner entre eux pendant le combat, et même de les utiliser simultanément pour réaliser des attaques spéciales uniques.

Rage of the Dragons NEO propose :
– Système de combat en duo : choisissez deux combattants et alternez entre eux en temps réel pour créer des techniques et des combos dévastateurs.
– Personnages emblématiques : découvrez une galerie de combattants aux styles uniques, chacun avec sa propre histoire et des capacités allant du traditionnel au surnaturel.
– Mode arcade classique : revivez l’âge d’or des jeux de combat avec le mode arcade, en affrontant une série d’adversaires pour décrocher le titre de champion.

Et encore :
– Mode Versus
– Mode Entraînement
– Dragon Challenge, un nouveau mode exclusif
– Matchs classés ou décontractés
– Lobby jusqu’à 8 joueurs
– Replay avec reprise de contrôle
– Tous les modes en ligne avec rollback netcode
– Jukebox, choisissez la musique des menus
– Plus de 80 combinaisons d’équipes en mode classique

La Version Standard de Rage of the Dragons NEO inclut :
– Cartouche du jeu
– Jaquette simple face
– Boîtier plastique
– Manuel d’instructions

Ce jeu est en précommande.
Sortie prévue au premier trimestre 2026

name: Rage of the Dragons Neo SWITCH [US]
short_description: Rage of the Dragons brings back the adrenaline of 2D battles with refined gameplay, charismatic characters and a dual combat system that demands strategy and precision. In this game, every blow counts and every decision can be the difference between victory and defeat.
description:
GET READY FOR THE FURY!

Rage of the Dragons brings back the adrenaline of 2D battles with refined gameplay, charismatic characters and a dual combat system that demands strategy and precision. In this game, every blow counts and every decision can be the difference between victory and defeat.
Rage of the Dragons NEO is a PC version of Rage of the Dragons, released in 2002 for arcades. It was a unique and innovative game, mainly due to its highly praised visuals and technical aspects at the time. With beautiful scenery and animations, incredible moves and an acclaimed soundtrack, it’s a must-have for any fighting game lover.
Famous for being very challenging, Rage of the Dragons NEO is based on tag team battles where the player uses two characters, controlling one at a time, being able to alternate them during combat, and being able to use both at the same time to perform unique special moves.

Rage of the Dragons NEO features:
– Dual combat system: choose two fighters and switch between them in real time, creating devastating tricks and combos.
– Iconic characters: Meet a gallery of fighters with unique styles, each with their own story and abilities ranging from the traditional to the supernatural.
– Classic arcade mode: Relive the golden days of fighting games with arcade mode, taking on a series of opponents in pursuit of the title of champion.

And more:
– Versus mode
– Training mode
– Dragon Challenge – new exclusive mode
– Ranked or casual matches
– Lobby for up to 8 players
– Replay with take over
– All online modes with netcode rollback
– Jukebox – choose the music to play in the menus
– Over 80 team combinations in classic mode

The Regular Version of Rage of the Dragons NEO includes:
– Game cartridge
– Single sided cover Sleeve
– Plastic Case
– Instruction Manual

This game is available for pre-order.
Expected release date: first quarter of 2026

name: Beyond the Ice Palace 2 SWITCH [EUR] – PXM #16
short_description: Rise from the depths of the underworld as the ‘Cursed King’ in Beyond The Ice Palace 2, an intense action-platformer blending fast-paced combat, exploration, and strategic progression. Wield the chains that once imprisoned you to battle formidable foes, traverse perilous landscapes, and reclaim your fallen kingdom.
description:
Rise from the depths of the underworld as the ‘Cursed King’ in Beyond The Ice Palace 2, an intense action-platformer blending fast-paced combat, exploration, and strategic progression. Wield the chains that once imprisoned you to battle formidable foes, traverse perilous landscapes, and reclaim your fallen kingdom.

The sequel to the mythical Beyond The Ice Palace, released in 1988 and published by Elite Systems, this new opus revisits the dark, mystical universe of the original game while bringing a richer, more modern experience.

Story:
Long ago, your throne was usurped, and your body cast into the abyss. Now resurrected, you embark on a relentless quest for vengeance. To break the curse binding your soul, you must retrieve the scattered fragments of celestial arrows, unlocking your true power. Only by vanquishing colossal demons and unearthing lost treasures can you reclaim your rightful place as king.

Key Features:
– Use the very chains that once bound you as deadly weapons and traversal tools.
– Discover hidden chambers, secret paths, and ancient relics to strengthen your abilities.
– Collect power crystals and upgrade your skills to overcome relentless adversaries.
– Face monstrous foes in intense, skill-based encounters requiring precision and strategy.
– Navigate beautifully crafted, atmospheric environments filled with danger and mystery.

Will you break free from your curse and reclaim your throne? The journey awaits.

BONUS INCLUDED: Contains a download code for the game’s original soundtrack and reversible cover.

Limited to 2000 numbered copies + Exclusive reversible cover PixelHeart + Certificate of authenticity Official game PixelHeart.

name: Ganryu 2: Hakuma Kojirō SWITCH [EUR]
description:
Ganryu 2: Hakuma Kojirō is the sequel to the Ganryu game made by VISCO on NEOGEO, the universe takes place in a feudal fantasy Japan which is strongly inspired by the story of Takezo Musashi, whose adventures are unfolded in a series of books (mainly « The Stone and the Sword »).
You play as Miyamoto Musashi travelling through a 17th century fantasy Japan, from north to south to the island of Ganryū-jima.

Story:
Musashi decides to meditate and try his hand at art, in the north of Japan in the province of Hokkaido. During one of his meditations, a spirit made contact with him. « Miyamoto Musashi, our fight is not over, I am waiting for you to finish it once and for all! All of Japan will pay for your insult! I’m waiting for you Miyamoto Musashi! There is no doubt that this voice was that of Sasaki Kojirō, his body was defeated, but his spirit still remains and his intentions were destructive. Miyamoto Musashi then understood that he would have to travel across Japan and go to the island of Ganryū-jima, in the south, where he fought Sasaki Kojirō for the last time.

Features:
– PixelArt game inspired mainly by Shinobi 3 and Shadow Dancer.
– 4 main levels will feature a different season, in this order: Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter. The last level is the floating fortress, so the season principle does not apply there.
– Possibility of dasher, double jump, wall-jump.
– Use your sword and your Kunais to fight.
– Special abilities (The Kamis).

Standard Edition. (This product is not a limited edition.)

name: Andro Dunos 2 SWITCH [EUR]
description:
The sequel to the famous shoot’em up from Visco studio is coming to PixelHeart. It’s time to bring out your good old spaceship fighter in ANDRO DUNOS 2.

Once upon a time…
Andro Dunos (アンドロデュノス, in japanese) is a side scrolling arcade game from shoot’em up category (Shmup).
Developed by Visco and Distributed in 1992 by SNK ON Neo-Geo MVS and Neo-Geo AES.
Licensed by PixelHeart since 2020.

Some 28 years have passed since the Earth Defence deployed Yellow Cherry and Red Fox to stop the imminent invasion from an unknown alien race. 52 light years away on the edge of our galaxy the threat has reared its ugly head again and this time they mean business.
There’s just one thing to do, dust off the finest Earth Defence ships ever made and send the alien scum packing. It’s apparent that these relics from a war time that was forgotten had seen better days and only one ship the Yellow Cherry could be saved using parts from Red Fox which was critically damaged in the war of the past.
Are you up for the task of saving the earth?

In this pure homage to the classic 90’s Arcade shoot em up you take control of one of the most technologically advanced space ships ever made with 4 weapon sets which can be changed depending on what situation you are in between them taking out enemies from all angles.
Weapons can be upgraded by collecting pickups or in the end level upgrade screen up to a maximum of 7. You also can take advantage of Missile and Shield pickups which can also be powered up to level 7.
Each weapon builds up a charge when firing which unlocks the Hyper Shot which delivers a devastating blast to whatever gets in its way…but be warned it also leaves your weapon weak and your ship vulnerable until charged back up again.

Starting on earth battle your way through 7 stages powering your weapons up until you reach the edge of the galaxy and the secret base from where all enemy waves are being orchestrated from. You will need to use everything you have learned on the journey about your weapon sets to take out the final boss and restore peace to Earth once more.

Features:
– Flexible and efficient gameplay.
– Recover power ups by killing enemies.
– Arcade mode for those who want to jump straight into the action.
– Music composed by Allister Brimble (Alien Breed, Body Blows, Project-X, Colonization, Driver or Superfrog).

Standard Edition. (This product is not a limited edition.)

name: Guns N’ Runs SWITCH [EUR] – PXM #14
description:
In Guns N’ Runs, you take control of 8 skillful members of the Conspiracy Squad, in a stylish run and gun, totally drawn by hand in pixel art, at the battle against a prodigy technopath and his army of robots.

Help our protagonists in the invasion of a bunker in the middle of the Atacama desert, in a capture and rescue mission full of challenges and dangers. Made for one player, with over 200 challenges, 23 bosses and focused on the individual narrative of each of the squad members.

The controls are simple and accessible – you can jump, shoot, dash and use the special – but make no mistake! The game possesses layers of progression that require a greater depth of skills to advance to the next levels. In this game, you will learn a new lesson with each death.

Use a variety of weapons, protect yourself with a shield, recover your dash to utilize it in sequence, destroy some enemies with a strengthened dash (if you have found it) and enjoy every second of the game with an original soundtrack that will leave you excited with each new stage.

So, prepare yourself to overcome your limits.

Features:
– Choose your character from the 8 members of the Conspiracy Squad.
– More than 200 challenges to overcome.
– 23 bosses, each more difficult than the last.
– Easy to understand controls that require mastery.
– A variety of weapons for both attack and defence.

Limited to 2000 numbered copies + Exclusive cover PixelHeart + Certificate of authenticity Official game PixelHeart.

name: Andro Dunos 2 Boîte Édition Limitée SWITCH [EUR]
description:
La suite du célèbre Shoot’em up du studio Visco arrive sous licence PixelHeart. Il est temps de ressortir votre bon vieux vaisseau de combat dans ANDRO DUNOS 2.

Il était une fois…
Andro Dunos (アンドロデュノス, en japonais) est un jeu d’arcade à scrolling horizontal de la famille des shoot ’em up (shmup).
Développé par Visco et distribué par SNK en 1992 sur Neo-Geo MVS et Neo-Geo AES.
Sous licence PixelHeart depuis 2020.

28 ans se sont écoulés depuis que la Défense de la Terre a déployé Yellow Cherry et Red Fox pour arrêter l’invasion imminente d’une race extraterrestre inconnue. À 52 années-lumière de là, aux confins de notre galaxie, la menace a refait surface et cette fois elle est sérieuse. Il n’y a qu’une seule chose à faire : dépoussiérer les meilleurs vaisseaux de défense de la Terre jamais construits et renvoyer la racaille extraterrestre. Il est évident que ces reliques d’une guerre oubliée ont connu des jours meilleurs et seul un vaisseau, le Yellow Cherry, a pu être sauvé grâce à des pièces du Red Fox, gravement endommagé lors de la dernière guerre. Êtes-vous prêt à sauver la Terre ?

Dans ce pur hommage au classique shoot em up des années 90, vous prenez les commandes de l’un des vaisseaux spatiaux les plus avancés technologiquement jamais construits. Avec 4 configurations d’armes qui peuvent être changées en fonction de la situation dans laquelle vous vous trouvez, éliminez vos ennemis sous tous les angles.

Les armes peuvent être améliorées jusqu’à un maximum de 7 niveaux en ramassant des objets ou dans l’écran d’amélioration de fin de zone. Vous pouvez également profiter des missiles et des boucliers ramassés qui peuvent également être améliorés jusqu’au niveau 7. Chaque arme se charge lorsqu’elle est utilisée, ce qui débloque l’Hyper Shot, un tir dévastateur sur tout ce qui se trouve sur son chemin… mais attention, il affaiblit votre arme et rend votre vaisseau vulnérable jusqu’à ce qu’il soit rechargé.

Commencez sur la Terre et traversez 7 étapes en alimentant vos armes jusqu’à atteindre le bord de la galaxie et la base secrète d’où tous les assauts ennemis sont orchestrés. Vous devrez utiliser tout ce que vous avez appris sur vos armes au cours du voyage pour éliminer le boss final et restaurer la paix sur Terre.

Caractéristiques :
– Gameplay souple et efficace.
– Récupérez des power up en abattant les ennemis.
– Musique composée par Allister Brimble (Alien Breed, Body Blows, Project-X, Colonization, Driver ou Superfrog).
– Mode arcade pour entrer immédiatement au coeur de l’action.

Tirage en série limitée : 2000 exemplaires numérotés + Certificat d’authenticité jeu officiel PixelHeart / Just For Games.
(1000 exemplaires disponibles sur notre site)

Cette boîte en Édition Limitée contient :
– La boîte de jeu standard (Jeu inclus + jaquette standard)
– FuturePak (Boîte métallique format Switch)

name: Wallachia: Reign of Dracula SWITCH [EUR]
description:
Wallachia: Reign of Dracula is a retro-style action and shooting game inspired by great video game classics such as the famous Castlevania.

The game was developed by Migami Games studios who also created popular fan games such as Castlevania The Lecard and Chronicles 2. Wallachia features the talents of professional voice actors, including Kira Buckland (Nier Automata) and Robert Belgrade (Alucard in Castlevania). The game also boasts a unique soundtrack and a story based on the legend of Vlad the Impaler, rather than typical vampire myths. In addition to its 7 levels of action, Wallachia: Reign of Dracula includes numerous bonuses and mini-games. Also discover the exclusive bonus from Bloodstained Ritual of the Night.

Players play as the new protagonist Elcin Floarea who will face Vlad Dracula and free Wallachia from his tyrannical rule once and for all.

Features:
– Complete gameplay with unparalleled difficulty.
– Waves of enemies to fight.
– Bosses that won’t give you a chance.
– A resolutely modern game with all the complexity of a retro game.

A little girl enters a portal to a world of fantasy called Exidus attempting to save her favorite plush friend…
